scope: Outside-host SSH inspection and explicit early-preparation cleanup
verified: The outside-host controller executes the real native worker through separate key-authenticated SSH accounts with strict host-key verification.
Both accounts use identical pinned worker dependencies and separately pinned private native configurations; production selects /usr/bin/php8.2 explicitly.
A changed dependency, changed native configuration or wrong SSH account refuses before native control state is created.
The application account permanently selects and verifies preparation abort before the master can select it, preventing incompatible recovery directions after possible SQL.
An interrupted committed database upgrade refuses early cleanup and leaves the master's control state unchanged for paired recovery.
Completed outcomes are recovered through fresh native inspection after an intentionally dropped SSH reply without repeating the completed action.
Concurrent edits on either account prevent service restoration; resuming a pending abort requires an explicit matching owner and phase.
Restoration and completion obtain a fresh challenged inspection through the other authenticated SSH account.
The complete controller sequence restores both real native schedules and web routing and verifies the original state again after restart.
Early cleanup runs with the database connection file removed; independent native database fingerprints, HTTP and scheduler checks confirm original data and service state.

operational_scope.target: Existing reviewed Core operation only; both native account configurations must already be staged privately.
operational_scope.receipt: Fresh exclusive local file records the requested command before execution, then the verified native results.
operational_scope.unknown_native_outcome: Stop and inspect; do not infer success, retry native mutations or select database recovery automatically.
operational_scope.pending_abort: Explicit resume requires both the account and phase matching its durable native intent.

limits: The controller has no forward deployment, SQL upgrade, database restore, cache activation or payment path.
Live writer observations, held backup streaming and full-candidate execution coordination remain to be connected and rehearsed.
No live maintenance, production migration, public code replacement, provider mutation or financial execution occurred.
Exact-commit CI must also run all existing guarded upgrade, activation and paired-recovery scenarios.
